description: Auto-allocate wounds OFF (default behaviour): with the setting disabled the WoundAllocationOverlay must wait for the player to click models — it must NOT auto-resolve. Disables the setting, drives ShootingController._on_saves_required with a 4-wound attack against Boyz F, waits, and verifies the overlay is still awaiting selection with no wounds allocated and no casualties applied. Legacy 10e regression: per-wound allocation through the WoundAllocationOverlay (the defender clicks one model per wound; awaiting_selection / allocation_history), which ShootingController/FightController only build below edition 11 — 11e 05.03 replaced it ("Create Groups: Divide all models in the target unit into the following groups ... The opposing player makes one save roll for each attack that wounded the target"); 11e coverage: pad_allocate_attacks_interactive_11e (auto-allocate OFF, the AllocationGroupOverlay waits for Roll Saves) and defender_control_saves_11e.
